# appsignal_log_view (Resource)

A saved view in the log viewer of an AppSignal app. AppSignal makes one when a log source is created in its UI, but not when a source is created through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_log_view" "vector" {
  app_id     = appsignal_app.web.id
  name       = "AWS ECS containers Vector"
  source_ids = [appsignal_log_source.vector.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `columns` (List of String) Attributes shown as extra columns, in order. AppSignal does not check the names.
- `line_height` (String) Line height as the log viewer stores it. Defaults to `0`, the value of views made in the UI.
- `query` (String) Log query in AppSignal's query syntax. AppSignal does not validate it, so check it in the log viewer first.
- `source_ids` (Set of String) Log sources the view shows.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_log_view.vector <app_id>/<log_view_id>
```
